actual.red: By the time Wendel Red reached S-F1, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A bullet found Wendel Red at S-F1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Red. Wendel Red read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
sugar_cubes745: On Day 3, Zeno Cubes arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Zeno Cubes put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Officers came to inspect R-F18. Zeno Cubes polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A sniper's bullet hit Zeno Cubes at R-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Zeno Cubes finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The surgeon worked on Zeno Cubes until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.
A letter came with Gideon "Mud" Cubes: "I am Zeno Cubes's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
